description: This file contains unit tests for MySQL storage implementation in an Orleans-based persistence layer. It defines a test class 'MySqlStorageTests' inheriting from 'RelationalStorageTests' and includes multiple test methods marked with attributes for test categories and execution control, testing various persistence behaviors and data handling scenarios.

classes.name: MySqlStorageTests
classes.description: Unit test class for MySQL storage, inheriting from RelationalStorageTests, designed to verify persistence behaviors specific to MySQL backend within Orleans storage system.
